sections.title: We're here to help
sections.content: If something in MigraineKit looks wrong, or you need help with a purchase, write to us and we will reply as soon as we can.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: Email us. We aim to reply within 1–2 business days.

sections.title: Your diary
sections.content: There is no account. Entries stay on the iPhone where you typed them. Deleting the App removes that diary from the phone. A purchase can be restored. The entries cannot.

sections.title: Purchases
sections.content: Pro is billed by Apple to your Apple ID. The yearly plan renews until you cancel it. The lifetime purchase is paid once. To manage or cancel the yearly plan:
list: On iPhone: Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions.
